what: Crypto's paid checks run weekly: the night test on Sundays (UTC), one crypto brief on Sunday mornings (Toronto), the crypto morning review on Mondays. Paper trading is unchanged.
until: Madhav says so; when the exposure dial opens (Bitcoin above its 50-day and 200-day averages) his phone gets one note asking whether to go back to daily.
